legal_defaults.ai_disclosure: This book's puzzles and layout were generated and verified by software; cover and interior art are original works. No AI-generated text is presented as human authorship.
legal_defaults.originality_attestation_template: Original work created via deterministic code generation and original illustration; no protected reference was traced or closely derived; no living artist imitated by name or style.

child_safety_policy.kids-4-8: friendly/familiar imagery only; no scary/dark/ambiguous-threat; large cells+type; forgiving difficulty
child_safety_policy.kids-6-10: positive imagery; modest progression; no violence/sexualisation/disturbing themes
child_safety_policy.tween-8-12: no horror/graphic-violence/age-inappropriate social themes; school/family safe

notes: Copy to company.local.json and complete before production. human_gates sets the number of distinct approvers each gate requires; release requires two by default. auto_approve_gates is a per-gate map: 'silent' records with default_approver and no prompt; 'auto' shows a card + one-tap confirm; 'false' collects a full interactive decision. A legacy single-string value (false|auto|silent) is still accepted and applies to every gate. Safety overrides always fall through to interactive when evidence is not PASS or a blocker/major finding is open; compliance and release remain human-decided. legal_defaults holds company-wide legal/rights posture (AI-disclosure text, rights posture, originality-attestation template, release-scope defaults, child-safety policy); it is copied into each new project's project.yaml under production.legal_defaults at init so the human confirms only deltas at the compliance and release gates. These are DEFAULTS, not clearances: default_asset_rights_status 'unknown-blocks-release' preserves the rule that clearance is never inferred from missing evidence.
